# TinyXML-2

Vendored upstream version 11.0.0 from https://github.com/leethomason/tinyxml2/tree/11.0.0 .
The unmodified source, header and license are retained here. Used for bounded
Nmap XML parsing; no runtime download or external XML dependency is required.
Upstream release: https://github.com/leethomason/tinyxml2/releases/tag/11.0.0 .
